CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 25, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – February 25, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Anki Udani, Chairman; Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai;
  Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – February 11, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the February 11, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the February 11, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

  1
  02/25/2025
 D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-104
  • 103 North Chapel Avenue
  • Applicant: Tish Scialampo & Barry Kyler
  • Request: This is an application for one (1) new blade sign on an
  existing 5-story mixed use building for the building complex name
  “Lantern Terrace.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1) Show the proposed blade sign height measured from finish grade
  to bottom or top of sign.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Show the proposed blade sign height measured from finish grade
  to bottom or top of sign.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-154
  • Address: 1905 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Stefanie Cao
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel that includes
  removal of unpermitted patio enclosure, and removal of a door and
  windows on an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without Conditions of Approval.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the proposed East facing window operation / type to give
  the appearance of a single stile or window pane.
  2) Add a window trim on the proposed East facing window.
  3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  2
  02/25/2025
   •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 24-058 Review No.2
  • Address: 208 North Granada Avenue
  • Applicant: Sarina Troung
  • Request: This is an application for a new 400 SF. addition and
  exterior remodel for an existing 1-story single-family house.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without Conditions of Approval.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Add a note on the plans that states all existing rafter tails/brackets
  are to remain and, if removed, replaced to match existing style
  and color.
  2) Increase the window height for proposed window #14 to 5 ft. and
  align sill height with other bedroom windows on the project.
  3) Update the window schedule to indicate all proposed window
  styles / operation.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-066
  • Address: 718 North Dos Robles
  • Applicant: Marmar Eslampour
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel to an existing 1-
  story single-family residence.

  3
  02/25/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE OR CONTINUE - The proposed
  project is approved as presented or continue with the
  recommendation that the Design Review Board discuss the
  application and provide the applicant and City staff with direction to
  how to proceed with the proposed wall cladding material.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following considerations:

  1) The applicant should study the front porch design and work with
  the City Architect on selecting alterative materials.
  2) The applicant should study the window details including selecting
  an appropriate scale for trim and sill.
  3) The applicant should include color elevations in the resubmittal
  set of drawings for review.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:25 P.M. to
  Tuesday, March 11, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
